system.description: Starting at 14th Level, your Crash-Maelstrom state rages grinding away stone and sheering other solid structures with droplets of water alone. When you would become a Maelstrom, by spending 2 Focus as part of entering the enhanced state, you instead become an Abyss. While an Abyss, you gain the benefits of being a Maelstrom, you can inflict Tidal Draw on all creatures affected by a Ninjutsu you cast with the Water release keyword and each time a you deal Chakra damage to a creature, you regain 1 Focus. But while an Abyss, you instead increase each instance of damage you take by +4.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
